7.3.3 Configuration
[SWS_BSW_00250] Enabling and disabling reporting of security events
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00489
⌈The BSW module shall provide a configuration switch to enable reporting of security
events from the BSW module to the IdsM. The switch shall be located in the General
container of the module.
Shortname: <ModuleName>EnableSecurityEventReporting
Longname: Enable Security Event Reporting
The default setting of the switch shall be Off.⌋
